name: exam-review
description: Run structured study review sessions for the user's coursework in five modes — diagnostic gap-finding, one-at-a-time active recall, full practice exams, Quizlet/Anki flashcard export, and condensed cheat sheets. Use whenever he asks to be quizzed, tested, or reviewed; asks what he should study, where he's weak, or whether he's ready; asks for flashcards, a practice test, or a cheat sheet; says "quiz me," "test me," "review chapter X," or mentions an upcoming exam. Works for ANY subject — accountin
